name: investment-toolkit-plugins
description: Investment Toolkit plugins: AI stock valuation, portfolio thesis balancing, and suite orchestration.

plugins.name: stock-valuation
plugins.description: AI-driven autonomous stock valuation engine. Produces Bear/Base/Bull scenario projections, persists structured JSON for the app UI, and generates deep-dive research reports with interactive Q&A.

plugins.name: thesis-balancer
plugins.description: Portfolio health monitor and strategic thesis alignment engine. Detects drift, flags Thesis Breaker conditions, and resolves Strategic Conflicts.

plugins.name: toolkit-manager
plugins.description: Orchestrator for the Investment Screener suite. Handles server startup (/start-screener) and Questrade API token seeding (/setup-questrade).
